---
title: Code Annotations (cross-reference and citation in an item)
bibliography: refs.bib
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'quarto-annotation-item\("annotated-cell-1", 1, \[\s*Compare with #ref\(<fig-x>, supplement: \[Figure\]\)'
          - 'quarto-annotation-item\("annotated-cell-1", 2, \[\s*See @knuth'
        -
          - '#cite\(<fig-x>'
---

```{.python}
x = 1  # <1>
y = 2  # <2>
```

1. Compare with @fig-x.
2. See [@knuth].

![A figure](fig.png){#fig-x}
